## Change

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link the issue if there is one.

## Checks

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Hardware testing

Name the exact hardware, USB IDs, distribution and kernel tested, plus the pixdial version or commit.
Describe the steps and results. If you used only fake hardware, say so.
Remove serial numbers, private paths and credentials from logs.

## Visual changes

Include images when the change affects a design. Explain any golden image updates.
